Likely stainless steel interior (for insulation) with a textured rubberized grip in the middle featuring a herringbone/tread pattern

The Grippy Grip Suction Mug (350 ml) brings together practical innovation and sleek style. Designed with a smart suction base, it anchors securely to desks, counters, or tables to help prevent spills and tipping — a must-have for busy workspaces, homes, or travel. Despite its firm grip, the mug lifts effortlessly when picked up vertically, making it convenient to use every day.

With its 350 ml capacity, it’s perfect for your favorite beverages, whether coffee, tea, water, or juice. The ergonomic shape and unique grip-friendly design make it comfortable to hold, while its durable construction ensures long-lasting performance.

Compact yet eye-catching, the Grippy Grip Suction Mug is not only practical but also a stylish choice for corporate gifting, promotions, or festive giveaways. Add your brand or message to make it a premium keepsake your recipients will use and appreciate daily.

The Grippy Grip Suction Mug (350 ml) is the perfect companion for anyone who values convenience, style, and safety in their drinkware. Despite its strong hold, the lifts effortlessly when picked up vertically, offering a seamless drinking experience.

With a 350 ml capacity, it’s perfectly sized for coffee, tea, water, or juice, making it a versatile choice for daily use at home, the office, or on the go. The ergonomic grip-friendly design ensures a comfortable hold, while its durable construction and sleek finish provide long-lasting performance with a modern look.

Compact yet practical, the Grippy Grip Suction makes an excellent choice for corporate gifts, promotional giveaways, or festive premiums. When customized with a company logo or special message, it transforms into a memorable and useful gift that your recipients will enjoy every day.

Key Features:

  • MOQ 100 Units.
  • Price does not include GST, logo printing and delivery charges
  • Innovative Suction Base: Firmly grips flat surfaces to prevent accidental spills and tipping.
  • 350 ml Capacity: Perfect for coffee, tea, water, or juice in moderate servings.
  • Durable Construction: Premium outer shell with a hygienic stainless steel interior (if applicable) for long-lasting use.
  • Ergonomic Grip Design: Specially contoured for a secure, comfortable hold.
  • Easy Release Mechanism: Mug detaches easily when lifted straight up.
  • Stylish & Compact: Modern look that’s ideal for home, office, travel, or gifting.
  • Custom Branding Friendly: Smooth exterior surface suitable for printing logos or messages for promotions.
